caption: The drawing depicts a single tooled leather object, likely a decorative case or pouch, rendered in realistic detail. The object is brown in color and shows varying shades to indicate texture and depth, highlighting the natural appearance of leather. The main body has a rounded rectangular shape with scalloped and stitched edges. At the upper section, there is an embossed circular mark that reads "WINCHESTER MAKERS SAN FRANCISCO." The upper right side of the pouch appears to have a raised, scalloped edge with decorative stitching and a notch. The front is adorned with an ornate, tooled floral pattern centrally placed, consisting of multiple petals and stems with small dot accents. The object is decorated with several parallel lines of detailed stitching, and it has a small, round metal fastener in the middle of the floral design. The left side is flat, while the right side shows the three-dimensional, folded depth of the leather material. The background is a plain, beige or off-white color, and the artist's signature, "Bertha Semple," appears near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Saddle Bag
